name: Ugin, the Ineffable
oracle_text:
Colorless spells you cast cost {2} less to cast.
+1: Exile the top card of your library face down and look at it. Create a 2/2 colorless Spirit creature token. When that token leaves the battlefield, put the exiled card into your hand.
−3: Destroy target permanent that's one or more colors.
blocked_sentences: +1: Exile the top card of your library face down and look at it. Create a 2/2 colorless Spirit creature token. When that token leaves the battlefield, put the exiled card into your hand.

needs.what: a 2/2 colorless Spirit creature token (no abilities; not an artifact)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has spirit_1_1_c (1/1 colorless Spirit) and spirit_2_2_w (2/2 white Spirit), neither of which is a 2/2 colorless Spirit; substituting either changes the token's size or color, and color matters to Ugin's own -3 and to colorless-matters effects. The rest of the line looks sayable once the token exists: look_at_top amount 1 with destination exile, face_down and `as`, create_token with `as`, then a delayed_trigger (duration until_it_fires, trigger event leaves_battlefield with subject bound to the token) whose effect returns the bound exiled card to hand -- the worker who closes the token should verify the delayed trigger can read the exile binding.
